about.title: Healdsburg Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Healdsburg is a small city, but defective products cause harm here just as they do anywhere else — a faulty kitchen appliance in a Dry Creek Road home, a car part that fails along US-101, or farm equipment used on the vineyards surrounding town. When a product doesn't work the way it's supposed to, California law often lets an injured person pursue the manufacturer, distributor, or retailer under strict liability, meaning the focus is on whether the product was defective, not on proving someone was careless. We handle product liability claims for Healdsburg residents, and we help you understand your options without cost or pressure. If you were injured by a product, keeping it in the condition it was in after the incident can matter a great deal to any later claim. We can help you take that first step.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney About a Defective Product

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Path
items.desc: California often applies strict liability to defective products, so you generally don't have to prove the manufacturer was careless — just that the product was defective and caused your injury.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, which may widen the pool of parties we can investigate on your behalf.

items.title: Preserving the Product Matters
items.desc: Because these claims often hinge on examining the product itself, we can advise you early on how to keep it safe and unaltered for any investigation.

items.question: Do I have to prove the company was negligent?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California product liability claims frequently rely on strict liability, which focuses on whether the product itself was defective — in its design, manufacturing, or warnings — rather than on the company's carelessness. We can help sort out which legal theory fits your situation.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Try to keep it exactly as it was right after the incident, including any packaging, instructions, or parts that broke off. This can be important evidence, and we can advise on how to store or document it properly.

items.question: Is this connected to Healdsburg's crash reports on Healdsburg Avenue or US-101?
items.answer: Not directly — those public crash counts reflect traffic collisions, not defective products. But if a vehicle part or component failure contributed to a crash on a corridor like US-101, that could raise a separate product liability question worth discussing with us.

items.question: Do you charge anything for a case review?
items.answer: No. We offer free case reviews, and we typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. Contact us to discuss your situation without cost or obligation.
